shadows.name: case-review-dialog
shadows.purpose: Separate the focused case review modal from the dimmed board.

motion.name: entrance
motion.purpose: One restrained first-view entrance; content is visible by default and reduced-motion preferences disable it.

motion.name: section-snap
motion.purpose: Keep each scroll view aligned to one section; navigation highlights the section currently in view.

components.name: Warm information panel
components.description: Primary container for merchant metrics, activity, and records.
components.html:
Payment events

Recent outcomes from the simulated checkout.
components.css: .ds-panel { background: #fffefa; color: #17243b; border: 1px solid #ded9cf; border-radius: 12px; padding: 20px; } .ds-panel h2 { margin: 0; font: 650 17px/1.35 'DM Sans', sans-serif; letter-spacing: -0.025em; } .ds-panel p { margin: 5px 0 0; color: #5e6877; font: 400 12px/1.5 'DM Sans', sans-serif; } .ds-panel:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #ef4d1a; outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Navy feature panel
components.description: High-contrast surface for stock safety and focused merchant actions.
components.html:
Order safety

Release reserved inventory after a simulated payment failure.
components.css: .ds-feature { background: #17243b; color: #fff; border-radius: 12px; padding: 20px; } .ds-feature h2 { margin: 0; font: 650 17px/1.35 'DM Sans', sans-serif; letter-spacing: -0.025em; } .ds-feature p { max-width: 30ch; margin: 8px 0 0; color: #d2d7df; font: 400 11px/1.55 'DM Sans', sans-serif; }

components.name: Section rail item
components.description: Icon-only anchor to an in-page dashboard section, with an accessible label.
components.css: .ds-rail-item { display: grid; width: 42px; height: 42px; place-items: center; border-radius: 10px; color: #667080; transition: background .18s, color .18s, transform .18s; } .ds-rail-item svg { width: 20px; height: 20px; fill: none; stroke: currentColor; stroke-width: 1.7; stroke-linecap: round; stroke-linejoin: round; } .ds-rail-item:hover { background: #ebe7dc; color: #17243b; transform: translateY(-1px); } .ds-rail-item:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #ef4d1a; outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Semantic status chip
components.description: Compact status treatment; success and failure colors communicate recorded payment outcomes.
components.css: .ds-status { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; border-radius: 8px; background: #edf3e9; padding: 5px 8px; color: #345d3c; font: 600 9px/1.3 'DM Sans', sans-serif; } .ds-status:hover { background: #e0eadb; } .ds-status:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #ef4d1a; outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Case board card
components.description: Draggable case summary with merchant, issue, order, amount, and review action.
components.css: .ds-case { background: #fffefa; color: #17243b; border: 1px solid #ded9cf; border-radius: 10px; padding: 12px; cursor: grab; } .ds-case small, .ds-case p { color: #5e6877; font: 400 10px/1.5 'DM Sans', sans-serif; } .ds-case h3 { margin: 8px 0 4px; font: 650 13px/1.4 'DM Sans', sans-serif; } .ds-case button { color: #17243b; font: 650 11px 'DM Sans', sans-serif; text-decoration: underline; text-underline-offset: 3px; } .ds-case:focus-within { outline: 3px solid #ef4d1a; outline-offset: 2px; }

narrative.northStar: A warm, calm merchant desk that makes operational evidence easy to scan.
narrative.overview: The merchant console pairs a warm off-white canvas with ivory panels, deep navy text and feature surfaces, and restrained orange and lime accents. It makes payment state and inventory consequences visible together while keeping simulated data and evidence limits explicit. The case workspace uses a compact Kanban board and focused review modal; dashboard metrics remain tied to persisted merchant-scoped records.
keyCharacteristics: A 72px icon rail preserves section-based navigation.
The activity stream is sourced from persisted orders and cases.
Deep navy panels provide contrast inside a warm light workspace.
Inventory events are never invented when the ledger does not record them.
Case cards can move between review states and retain full evidence review access.

rules.name: Evidence first
rules.body: Show what records establish and what remains unknown.

rules.name: Quiet surfaces
rules.body: Use warm borders and spacing for hierarchy; reserve navy for feature panels.

rules.name: Semantic status
rules.body: Green and red communicate recorded payment or protection state, not decoration.

rules.name: Merchant scope
rules.body: Keep merchant attribution attached to catalog products and their orders and cases.

dos: Do label all customer, payment, and inventory values as simulated.
Do keep section anchors, visible focus states, and reduced-motion behavior.
Do show a clear empty state when the backing ledger has no event type.
Do keep the remembered merchant selection scoped to the case board.
donts: Don't infer fulfillment or customer intent from a payment outcome.
Don't crowd every operational record into the opening viewport.
